content:
Lina (CS): Quick summary from this morning's sync with Greenleaf Bio — pulling out the customer-facing asks and pain points so we can decide what to send to product. TL;DR: onboarding lag, inconsistent embeddings for medical terms, and a request for a cheaper dedupe option.

Maya (CS): Notes from call: 1) onboarding timeline slipped to 6 weeks (was 3) because of model size/timeouts, 2) embeddings mismatch on gene names (case + hyphenization), 3) want an SDK hook to sanitize PII before send.

Lina (CS): Important bits verbatim they asked to capture for product:```- Feature: lower-cost dedupe mode (approx 30% cheaper but slightly lower recall)
- Bug: embeddings drift on hyphenated gene tokens (e.g., "BRCA-1" vs "BRCA1")
- Enhancement: pre-send hook in SDK for customer-side PII redaction (configurable)
- Ops: clearer onboarding runbook for dedicated vs hosted differences
```

Aaron (CSM): Renewal flag: customer is in pilot; mentioned price sensitivity and we need a small win fast or risk pause. Suggested priority on the dedupe ask if it materially cuts cost. :warning:

Oliver (PM): Thanks. Two quick Qs: 1) is the embeddings issue reproducible on a small corpus we can share? 2) which deployment are they on (hosted/dedicated)?

Maya (CS): Repro steps in call notes — they ran 500 sample docs, I'll paste the snippet in a follow-up. They're on hosted but using a dedicated token and have bursty traffic.

Devlin (Eng): If it's tokenization-related we should check our tokenizer config + normalization. Can you share exact example pairs? low-effort check: run through our tokenize endpoint and compare.

Lina (CS): Example pair: "BRCA-1 mutation" -> embedding A, "BRCA1 mutation" -> embedding B. Customer says cosine drops from 0.89 to 0.55. They tried lowercasing already.

OnboardingBot: Greenleaf Bio onboarding status updated: stage -> "pilot: integration"; last_activity -> 2026-02-12; assigned_to -> Aaron (CSM).

Oliver (PM): Okay adding to backlog for triage. Proposed labels: customer:greenleaf-bio, severity:high, type:bug+enhancement. Can someone confirm the cost-savings target for the dedupe mode?

Aaron (CSM): They told us target is ~30% token cost reduction per dedupe run and acceptable recall drop <= 5%.

Devlin (Eng): I'll prototype a token-normalization fix and a quick quantized dedupe baseline. ETA: 3 business days for a spike.

Maya (CS): I'll upload the 500-sample repro set to the shared drive and link here within the hour.

Oliver (PM): Perfect. I'll open an internal ticket and link the repro + assign to Devlin. If prototype looks promising we can scope a small opt-in beta for Greenleaf and include cost/recall telemetry.

Lina (CS): Thanks all. Can we call out next steps explicitly: 1) Maya uploads repro (hour), 2) Devlin spikes (3 days), 3) Oliver creates ticket & plans beta, 4) Aaron communicates expectation to customer and gets buy-in for opt-in beta. I'll follow up with status on Friday. :thumbsup:

Aaron (CSM): I'll mention opt-in beta and cost target in my update. Also adding note: escalate to AM if we don't have a spike result in 4 days.

Devlin (Eng): Noted. If we need more data tagging for gene variants we might ask CS to collect a few edge cases.

Oliver (PM): Ticket created: RDW-2912 (internal) — linked to repo + shared drive (will paste link once Maya uploads). Labels set as discussed.

Lina (CS): Great — closing loop here. If anyone hears pushback from Greenleaf on timeline ping me.

Maya (CS): Uploaded repro here: drive.redwood/internal/greenleaf/repro_20260212.zip  :spiral_note_pad:

Devlin (Eng): Got it, downloading now. :eyes:

Oliver (PM): I'll update RDW-2912 with the link. Thanks team.

Aaron (CSM): Follow-up scheduled with customer on Wednesday.

Lina (CS): End of thread — small, customer-facing asks captured for product triage.
